<think>**Designing folded CRC logic**

</think>

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module axis_eth_fcs_reset(
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire [7:0] s_axis_tdata,
    input wire s_axis_tkeep,
    input wire s_axis_tvalid,
    output wire s_axis_tready,
    input wire s_axis_tlast,
    input wire s_axis_tuser,
    output wire [31:0] output_fcs,
    output wire output_fcs_valid
);
    reg [31:0] crc_state;
    reg [31:0] fcs_reg;
    reg fcs_valid_reg;
    wire [31:0] crc_next;
    wire [7:0] feedback;

    // Combine matching data and state terms before the parity network.
    assign feedback = crc_state[7:0] ^ s_axis_tdata;

    assign crc_next[0]  = crc_state[8]  ^ (^(feedback & 8'h04));
    assign crc_next[1]  = crc_state[9]  ^ (^(feedback & 8'h09));
    assign crc_next[2]  = crc_state[10] ^ (^(feedback & 8'h13));
    assign crc_next[3]  = crc_state[11] ^ (^(feedback & 8'h26));
    assign crc_next[4]  = crc_state[12] ^ (^(feedback & 8'h4d));
    assign crc_next[5]  = crc_state[13] ^ (^(feedback & 8'h9a));
    assign crc_next[6]  = crc_state[14] ^ (^(feedback & 8'h30));
    assign crc_next[7]  = crc_state[15] ^ (^(feedback & 8'h61));
    assign crc_next[8]  = crc_state[16] ^ (^(feedback & 8'hc2));
    assign crc_next[9]  = crc_state[17] ^ (^(feedback & 8'h80));
    assign crc_next[10] = crc_state[18] ^ (^(feedback & 8'h04));
    assign crc_next[11] = crc_state[19] ^ (^(feedback & 8'h08));
    assign crc_next[12] = crc_state[20] ^ (^(feedback & 8'h11));
    assign crc_next[13] = crc_state[21] ^ (^(feedback & 8'h23));
    assign crc_next[14] = crc_state[22] ^ (^(feedback & 8'h46));
    assign crc_next[15] = crc_state[23] ^ (^(feedback & 8'h8c));
    assign crc_next[16] = crc_state[24] ^ (^(feedback & 8'h1d));
    assign crc_next[17] = crc_state[25] ^ (^(feedback & 8'h3b));
    assign crc_next[18] = crc_state[26] ^ (^(feedback & 8'h77));
    assign crc_next[19] = crc_state[27] ^ (^(feedback & 8'hee));
    assign crc_next[20] = crc_state[28] ^ (^(feedback & 8'hd8));
    assign crc_next[21] = crc_state[29] ^ (^(feedback & 8'hb4));
    assign crc_next[22] = crc_state[30] ^ (^(feedback & 8'h6c));
    assign crc_next[23] = crc_state[31] ^ (^(feedback & 8'hd8));
    assign crc_next[24] = ^(feedback & 8'hb5);
    assign crc_next[25] = ^(feedback & 8'h6f);
    assign crc_next[26] = ^(feedback & 8'hdf);
    assign crc_next[27] = ^(feedback & 8'hba);
    assign crc_next[28] = ^(feedback & 8'h71);
    assign crc_next[29] = ^(feedback & 8'he3);
    assign crc_next[30] = ^(feedback & 8'hc3);
    assign crc_next[31] = ^(feedback & 8'h82);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst)
            crc_state <= 32'hffffffff;
        else if (s_axis_tvalid) begin
            if (s_axis_tlast)
                crc_state <= 32'hffffffff;
            else
                crc_state <= crc_next;
        end
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst)
            fcs_reg <= 32'h00000000;
        else if (s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tlast)
            fcs_reg <= ~crc_next;
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst || !s_axis_tvalid)
            fcs_valid_reg <= 1'b0;
        else
            fcs_valid_reg <= s_axis_tlast;
    end

    assign s_axis_tready = 1'b1;
    assign output_fcs = fcs_reg;
    assign output_fcs_valid = fcs_valid_reg;
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline critical paths traverse long serial XOR/XNOR networks between state registers and CRC/FCS destination registers, followed by update/reset selection. The reported worst path contains six XOR3 stages.",
  "rewrite": "Factor every matching low-state/data pair into an eight-bit feedback vector, then compute each CRC bit using a constant-masked reduction XOR and, where required, one upper-state bit. This exposes smaller parity networks instead of the original serial state-then-data XOR chains. Retain crc_state, fcs_reg, fcs_valid_reg and their encodings and update priorities.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "The reduced parity depth should improve setup WNS relative to 7.65 ns. A numerical improvement is not measured here; actual gain depends on synthesis factoring, buffering and SKY130HD mapping.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "No additional registers, pipeline stages or helper modules. Shared feedback terms should reduce XOR logic, though buffering may offset some savings. Compliance with the 5033.202240 um2 area cap and electrical limits requires evaluation of the mapped candidate.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the positive-edge clock and synchronous reset. Reset initializes CRC to all ones, FCS to zero and valid to zero. Valid input always updates CRC, with last resetting the running CRC while capturing the complemented current-byte CRC into FCS. FCS otherwise holds, including while invalid; output valid remains a registered valid-and-last indication suppressed by reset. Ready is always one. Keep and user remain ignored. No initialization, startup assumptions, extra latency or undefined outputs are introduced."
}
